DownloadSources.title: Download sources
DownloadSources.intro: Lists of games to download, in the format Hydra uses. They stay on this computer, and adding one downloads nothing.
DownloadSources.warning: Anyone can write a source, and Shelf can’t check where its links lead. A program from one runs with your access to this computer. Add only sources you trust, for games you have the right to download.
DownloadSources.added: Added {name}, with {count, plural, one {# download} other {# downloads}}. Nothing was downloaded.
DownloadSources.links: {magnets, number} by magnet link, {web, number} by web link
DownloadSources.leftOut: {count, plural, one {# left out: nothing in it Shelf can use} other {# left out: nothing in them Shelf can use}}
DownloadSources.readDone: Read {name}: {count, plural, one {# download} other {# downloads}}.
DownloadSources.removeBody: Its list leaves this computer. You can add it again from its address.

errors.invalid: That isn’t an https address Shelf can read. Addresses on this computer or its network aren’t read.
errors.unreachable: That address didn’t answer with a file. Check it and try again.
errors.large: That file is too large to be a source.
errors.unsupported: That address has no source: a source is a JSON file with a name and a list of downloads.
errors.missing: That source is no longer here.
errors.failed: This computer couldn’t keep that. Try again.
